name: Vocal FE
description: All-in-One Vocal Front-End: 2-pole Butterworth HPF, sidechain-filtered smart gate with hold and floor clamp, zero-latency relative split-band de-esser, and Pade tanh peak catcher.

params.name: Gate
params.explanation: Smart vocal gate open threshold (-55..-15 dBFS; close is 5 dB lower + 100 ms hold).

params.name: Floor
params.explanation: Gate closed floor clamp (-40..0 dB; default -18 dB tames feedback without dead dropouts).

params.name: DeEss
params.explanation: Relative split-band de-esser sensitivity (0..100; capped at -10 dB max cut).

params.name: Drive
params.explanation: Pre-clipper vocal drive / peak catcher ceiling push (0..12 dB).
